items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 5 June 2026 10:29pm
items.description:
##Today##

Wet and windy start to the day. The rain or drizzle then largely clearing away around lunchtime but staying cloudy with further hill fog patches into the afternoon. Cloud may lift off the hills for a time as it becomes dry late afternoon ahead of further rain later in the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

SE 20-25, 25-30 gusts 40 in places, gradually decreasing 10-15 during morning and afternoon, then veering West late in day. Backing SW 10-15 overnight, 15-20 in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate at times in the rain/ drizzle at first. Hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first.


##Tomorrow##

Mostly dry for much of the day with only a little patchy rain, but becoming breezy and rain then arriving around evening, continuing for a time before clearing later in night.


##Temperature##

##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing for a time.
